errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states that Industry in the first chart has 8% and 2.4 mln, but the figure shows Industry with 61% and 19.0 mln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Construction in the first chart has 12% and 3.7 mln, but the figure shows Construction with 8% and 2.4 mln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Other services in the first chart have 61% and 19.0 mln, but the figure shows Other services with 12% and 3.7 mln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Industry in the second chart has 21% and 33.0 mln, but the figure shows Industry with 51% and 80.2 mln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Other services in the second chart have 51% and 80.2 mln, but the figure shows Other services with 21% and 33.0 mln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Industry in the third chart has 33% and 10.6 tln, but the figure shows Industry with 31% and 9.8 tln.
The machine description incorrectly states that Other services in the third chart have 31% and 9.8 tln, but the figure shows Other services with 33% and 10.6 tln.
The machine description does not explicitly state that the charts represent enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021.
The machine description does not mention that the sectors are not visually ordered by size in any of the charts.
